leads.headline: Russian missiles hit three Kyiv bridges
leads.detail: Missiles and drones hit three bridges over the Dnipro in an overnight barrage, among the largest of the war. At least eight people were killed and dozens injured across Ukraine. A Lviv railway-station strike killed two, the mayor said.

leads.headline: Cyclone Akvan makes landfall on India’s east coast
leads.detail: More than 300,000 people were moved to shelters. No deaths were reported in early accounts.

leads.headline: An AI sell-off sinks Asian stocks
leads.detail: Taiwan’s index fell about 6.2%, its worst week since 1991 in reports. Seoul, Tokyo and Hong Kong also closed sharply lower.

features.headline: Britain and the EU seal food and youth deals
features.detail: Friday’s summit eased food trade and boosted youth travel. They called it a reset, and left broader talks open.

features.headline: COP31 reaches its last day deadlocked
features.detail: A slimmed-down draft dropped a fossil-fuel phase-out. A $120bn adaptation-finance gap was unresolved.

features.headline: Poland says Russia violated its airspace
features.detail: Overnight objects included a cruise missile. Prime Minister Tusk said the incursion appeared intentional.

features.headline: Iraqi forces enter Jurf al-Sakhar
features.detail: Security forces entered the Kataib Hezbollah stronghold under a government order targeting the group.

features.headline: CGIL stages a general strike
features.detail: Italy’s largest union walked out. Thousands of workers and students protested Meloni’s economic policies.

features.headline: Japan’s October prices rise 2.3%
features.detail: The consumer-price reading keeps a Bank of Japan rate-hike debate in view.

features.headline: Ruling party moves to impeach the chief justice
features.detail: The move follows a court clearing ex-president Han Dong-hoo and overturning a conviction.

features.headline: Kenya starts drilling its first oil well
features.detail: Work began in Turkana. First crude was described as due around 1 December.

features.headline: Bukele files to run for a third term
features.detail: The president entered the 28 February 2027 race after a 2025 change ended term limits.

features.headline: Phillips scores 118 against India
features.detail: Glenn Phillips now has centuries in all three formats against India in a year.

briefs.line: A railway-station strike kills two, the mayor says.
Police say they thwarted a Russian plot to kill rapper Kyivstoner; Copenhagen expels Russia’s defence attaché.
Parliament moves to close road crossings with Russia for six months after sabotage blamed on the GRU.
Houthis say 41 killed as Saudi-led strikes hit Hodeidah and other targets; the coalition says the sites were military.
The Treasury sanctions four Iranian oil trustees accused of evading sanctions.
The White House replaces cyber director Sean Cairncross with Kirsten Davies amid US tech outages.
Back from China, Trump says at a Friday briefing that the three leaders agreed a nuclear war “cannot be won and must never be fought.”
Two veto-wielding Security Council members reject Costa Rica’s Rebeca Grynspan in an informal poll for UN chief.
Imprisoned ex-president Jair Bolsonaro is hospitalised with an intestinal obstruction.
Hackers post contact data for thousands of JPMorgan Chase customers.
The app restricts screenshots, saying it wants to block AI agents from reading messages.
The SEC is probing Nvidia’s accounting practices, two people briefed on the matter say.
Anthropic’s IPO haul rises to $93.5 billion after underwriters exercise the greenshoe.
The Senate approves a police-shootings law critics call a “licence to kill.”
Child deaths and injuries in the Ukraine war this year are on track to rival 2022.
Turkey says it is starting offshore hydrocarbon exploration in Pakistan, with drilling planned next year.
At least four people die after a migrant boat capsizes; around 50 were reported aboard.
More regions limit fuel sales after Ukrainian drone strikes on refineries.
SoftBank and other Asian tech names lead the regional slide.
Wall Street is also under pressure as the AI trade wobbles.
